PEP 621 distribution extras and installed-consumer test profiles are separate source facts.

facts.input_contract: Portfolio/benchmark returns and weights of matching shape.
facts.output_contract: Allocation, selection and interaction effects summing to active return.
facts.rationale: BHB decomposition with residual accounting; numerically verified.

facts.input_contract: Portfolio/benchmark return panels and optional portfolio weights.
facts.output_contract: Per-period Brinson--Hood--Beebower allocation, selection and interaction effects.
facts.rationale: Historical method alias for the formula-tested BHB decomposition; it no longer exposes a stub.

facts.input_contract: Asset/portfolio returns plus factor returns (3/4/5 factor).
facts.output_contract: Fitted factor exposures, idiosyncratic risk and R-squared.
facts.rationale: Local multi-factor estimation; no network access required for the model itself.

facts.input_contract: Factor names and a date range; an injected provider is required.
facts.output_contract: Fama-French factor returns for the requested interval.
facts.rationale: Requires an external provider; no default network fetcher is bundled.

facts.input_contract: Portfolio returns and optional style factor returns.
facts.output_contract: Style tilts and regression-based attribution.
facts.rationale: Constrained style regression with documented coefficient semantics.

facts.input_contract: Style factor identifiers and a date range; an injected provider is required.
facts.output_contract: Style factor returns for the requested interval.
facts.rationale: Requires an external provider; no default network fetcher is bundled.

facts.input_contract: alphalens 0.4.0 source-shaped call signatures.
facts.output_contract: Source-shaped alphalens strict façade (Beta integration).
facts.rationale: Beta alphalens migration; use the tested APIs in the migration guide.

facts.input_contract: empyrical 0.6.0 call signatures and return shapes.
facts.output_contract: Numerically verified empyrical 0.6.0 results (C0-C3 gates).
facts.rationale: Frozen empyrical 0.6.0 surface pinned by tests/compat fixtures.

facts.input_contract: pyfolio 0.9.6 tear-sheet workflow signatures.
facts.output_contract: pyfolio 0.9.6-profile tear-sheet workflows (C1/C4 gates).
facts.rationale: Frozen pyfolio 0.9.6 profile behind the fincore[pyfolio] extra.

facts.output_contract: Chinese market price history DataFrame.
facts.rationale: Requires fincore[data-cn] and a working akshare install.

facts.input_contract: Symbol(s), date range and an API key; requests extra.
facts.output_contract: Price history DataFrame.
facts.rationale: Requires fincore[data-alphavantage] and an API key.

facts.input_contract: Symbol(s), date range and a Tushare token.
facts.output_contract: Chinese A-share price history DataFrame.
facts.rationale: Requires fincore[data-cn] and a Tushare token.

facts.input_contract: Symbol(s), date range; yfinance extra and a working transport.
facts.output_contract: Price history DataFrame with the provider's price-adjustment convention.
facts.rationale: Requires fincore[data-yahoo] and a reachable Yahoo Finance service.

facts.input_contract: A PreparedFactorData container.
facts.output_contract: FactorAnalysisModel with IC, quantile returns and turnover.
facts.rationale: Enhanced compute-only factor analysis; Beta integration.

facts.input_contract: Gross-normalized enhanced factor weights, same-currency dollar-volume panel, simple gross returns, an explicit FactorCostModel, and complete borrow ledgers whenever weights are short.
facts.output_contract: An immutable gross-to-net cost ledger with entry/rebalance trade weights, spread/impact/borrow costs, participation, and the binding hard capacity inequality.
facts.rationale: A labelled arithmetic accounting boundary with independent reconciliation fixtures; it is not an execution simulator, calibrated market-impact model, or complete research-trial workflow.

facts.input_contract: Labelled return and exposure panels with at least two assets; optional Newey-West requires a chronologically ordered returns index and an explicit lag count.
facts.output_contract: Cross-sectional intercept/exposure means, standard errors and t-statistics; DataFrame attrs disclose the i.i.d. or Newey-West covariance profile, lags, and fitted cross-section count.
facts.rationale: Asset-label alignment and Bartlett Newey-West standard errors are independently statsmodels-tested, but multi-factor, clustered, trial-registry, and report integration remain incomplete.

facts.input_contract: An enhanced FactorAnalysisModel plus an FDR alpha; uses its stored aggregate date-by-period IC snapshot.
facts.output_contract: ICInferenceResult with sample counts, two-sided Student-t p-values, BH q-values, discoveries, and an explicit untestable-period marker.
facts.rationale: Statsmodels/SciPy-oracle-tested IC/FDR post-analysis; IC tests remain i.i.d., while the separate Fama-MacBeth helper supports Newey-West. Trial registry, clustered inference, and report integration remain incomplete.

facts.input_contract: A point-in-time factor ledger with asset/as_of/known_at/effective_from/value/in_universe, prices, and sorted evaluation dates.
facts.output_contract: PreparedFactorData from revisions known and effective at each evaluation date; full-sample filter_zscore is rejected.
facts.rationale: Causal PIT materialization is independently timeline-tested, but corporate-action/calendar provenance, liquidity/borrow provenance, execution calibration, and complete workflow integration remain unsealed.

facts.input_contract: Factor, prices and optional groupby/quantile configuration.
facts.output_contract: A PreparedFactorData container with documented loss accounting.
facts.rationale: Enhanced prepare/analyze/render workflow; Beta integration.

facts.input_contract: Factor, prices, and unique forward periods; full-sample filter_zscore is rejected on this causal enhanced route.
facts.output_contract: A MultiHorizonPreparedFactorData mapping whose per-period PreparedFactorData and loss report retain observations available for that horizon.
facts.rationale: Per-horizon availability prevents long-horizon missing returns from removing short-horizon evidence, but costs, capacity, corporate-action/calendar provenance, and full workflow integration remain unsealed.

facts.input_contract: A FactorAnalysisModel or EventAnalysisModel.
facts.output_contract: Rendered tear-sheet figures with explicit close_owned_figures ownership.
facts.rationale: Enhanced rendering; requires fincore[alphalens] extra.

facts.input_contract: Validated periodic returns plus optional benchmark/positions/transactions/trades; an enhanced DisclosureContext declares cashflow, fee and unit semantics.
facts.output_contract: An HTML or PDF strategy report with calculation, units, sample and data-quality disclosure; optional provenance sidecar.
facts.rationale: Compute-once/render-many report pipeline with deterministic sections and explicit performance context.

facts.input_contract: A returns Series/array (excess or simple) with optional tail probability.
facts.output_contract: Tail-risk estimates (VaR/CVaR) with the fitted EVT parameters attached.
facts.rationale: Frozen EVT tail-risk kernels with pinned numerical fixtures.

facts.input_contract: A returns Series/array and model order parameters (p, q) — only (1, 1) is implemented.
facts.output_contract: Fitted conditional-volatility model with forecast and conditional VaR/ES.
facts.rationale: GARCH/EGARCH/GJR-GARCH (1,1) kernels with corrected forecast recursions and convergence checks; higher orders unsupported until fully verified.

facts.input_contract: A RiskModelSpec plus finite, sorted returns passed through walk_forward_var; only one-step, lower-tail VaR is currently supported.
facts.output_contract: A JSON-serializable event ledger containing every out-of-sample forecast, exception, refit, fit parameters, and input/backtest digests.
facts.rationale: The walk-forward VaR boundary has independent calibration and no-look-ahead checks, but it is experimental until broader risk-model validation and release gates are complete.
